mechanism_narrative: A 2% quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates strengthening economic demand, leading to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with 2%+ GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing borrowing costs and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS increases by 200,000+ in a month, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite strong labor market signals.

mechanism_narrative: A 1.5% monthly increase in INDPRO indicates supply chain acceleration, leading to increased productivity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 1,600,000 units, it signals a housing market boom, increasing consumer wealth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters with HOUST above 1,600,000 units.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 4% and CPIAUCSL increases by 0.5%+ in a month, it signals accommodative monetary policy with rising inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite accommodative policy and rising inflation expectations.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% decrease in UNRATE within 2 months signals improving labor market conditions, leading to increased consumer confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when RSAFS exceeds $400,000,000 and GDPC1 increases by 1%+ in a quarter, it signals robust aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with robust demand signals.
